scripts.predev:profile: pm2 delete tamtam 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti:1337 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; rm -f .next/dev/trace-turbopack; true
scripts.dev:profile: NEXT_TURBOPACK_TRACING=1 pm2 start 'next dev --port 1337 --hostname 127.0.0.1' --name tamtam --cwd . --time --update-env && echo '\n[dev:profile] reproduce the slow state, then `pnpm stop` to flush the trace to .next/dev/trace-turbopack — view via `npx next internal trace .next/dev/trace-turbopack` then open https://trace.nextjs.org/\n' && pm2 logs tamtam
scripts.predev:flamegraph: pm2 delete tamtam 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti:1337 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; mkdir -p .profiles && rm -f .profiles/CPU.*.cpuprofile; true
scripts.dev:flamegraph: pm2 start node --name tamtam --cwd . --time --update-env --interpreter none -- --cpu-prof --cpu-prof-dir=./.profiles ./node_modules/next/dist/bin/next dev --port 1337 --hostname 127.0.0.1 && echo '\n[dev:flamegraph] reproduce the slow state, then `pnpm stop` to flush the V8 CPU profile to ./.profiles/CPU.*.cpuprofile — open in Chrome DevTools (Performance → Load profile) or drop into https://www.speedscope.app/ for a flamegraph view\n' && pm2 logs tamtam
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm type-check && pnpm test
